dialogues.jp: 「主よ、不甲斐ないわたくしをお許しください」

居間でテレビを観ていたところを音夢に追い立
てられ、試験勉強を始めるも、ものの１分で挫
折する。
dialogues.en:
Having been chased upstairs from watching TV by Nemu to
begin studying for exams, I got discouraged after just one
hour.
dialogues.text:
Having been chased upstairs from watching TV by Nemu to
begin studying for exams, I got discouraged after just one
hour.

dialogues.jp: 「まあ、明日の夜にすれば大丈夫だろう」
dialogues.en: "Well, it'd be okay if I start tomorrow night."
dialogues.text: "Well, it'd be okay if I start tomorrow night."

dialogues.jp: これぞホントの一夜漬け。
dialogues.en: This will be some serious late-night cramming.
dialogues.text: This will be some serious late-night cramming.

dialogues.jp: 机の前を離れベッドに横たわる。
dialogues.en: I leave the front of my desk and flop into bed.
dialogues.text: I leave the front of my desk and flop into bed.

dialogues.jp:
まだそんなに遅い時間ではないが、さっき教科
書を見たばかりだから、問題なく眠れる。
dialogues.en:
Even though it's not that late yet, after staring at a
textbook for that long, I'm not going to have any problems
falling asleep.
dialogues.text:
Even though it's not that late yet, after staring at a
textbook for that long, I'm not going to have any problems
falling asleep.

dialogues.jp:
「とりあえず、目覚ましだけセットしておこう
　かな」
dialogues.en: "I should set the alarm clock too..."
dialogues.text: "I should set the alarm clock too..."

dialogues.jp:
半ば習慣になりつつあることに驚きつつ、時間
をセットする。
dialogues.en:
This was almost becoming a habit, as I reached out to set my
alarm clock.
dialogues.text:
This was almost becoming a habit, as I reached out to set my
alarm clock.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、勉強を続けた。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、勉強を続けた。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm, I continued studying.

dialogues.jp: 目覚ましをセットして、寝た。
dialogues.en: After setting the alarm, I slept.
dialogues.text: After setting the alarm, I slept.

dialogues.jp:
音夢に追い立てられて始めた試験勉強だったが、
１分と持たずに飽きてしまった。ま、明日があ
るさ。
dialogues.en:
Nemu chased me upstairs to start studying for exams, but I
got tired of it after just an hour. Well, there's always
tomorrow.
dialogues.text:
Nemu chased me upstairs to start studying for exams, but I
got tired of it after just an hour. Well, there's always
tomorrow.

dialogues.en: -This will be some serious late-night cramming.
dialogues.text: -This will be some serious late-night cramming.
